$comment: Specs skipped only by `bun run test:e2e:ledger`. Each entry is explained in docs/engine/e2e-ledger.md. Remove an entry in the same change that makes its test pass.

tests: editable Pen, canvas text, graph and preview controls render coherently
entries.reason: Timeout waiting for the "Text animator presets" group and its Rise button; that group no longer exists in src (removed in a5e3fbb6, 2026-10-05). Stale spec; the text animator UI it drives was redesigned.

tests: agent image attachments open a fitted preview and Escape returns focus
entries.reason: Escape closes the preview but focus does not return to the "View reference.png" trigger. Pointer-clicked buttons are blurred since 352f1d1e (2026-10-09, "Fix pointer-clicked buttons retaining keyboard focus"), so the trigger the spec clicks has no focus to restore. Product and spec disagree; decide which behavior is intended.

tests: the agent watches and listens to imported footage through the media tools
entries.reason: The final model request carries 8 data:image attachments; the spec expects 4 (2 frames + 1 sheet + 1 composition sheet). Suspected extra visual-context frames from e7e3ccb1 ("Improve agent visual context"). Agent snapshots move to the engine, so the count matters for the port.

tests: captions surfaces in light mode
entries.reason: Escape does not close the Export dialog, so Export Captions opens on top of it and locator('.export-modal') matches two dialogs (strict mode). Suspected cause: pointer-clicked buttons are blurred since 352f1d1e (2026-10-09, "Fix pointer-clicked buttons retaining keyboard focus"), after which the dialog no longer holds focus for Escape.

tests: captions surfaces in dark mode
entries.reason: Same failure as the light-mode case: two .export-modal dialogs (Export and Export Captions) are open at once.

tests: color picker stays above adjacent panels and inside the viewport
entries.reason: The first open passes; after Escape the inspector Fill row no longer contains a .color-field trigger and the loop times out (30 s). Suspected stale selector after the color picker unification (f8734eb3, 2026-09-25).

tests: flat controls remain consistent across home, editor, settings, library, and export in both themes
entries.reason: In the dark editor the selected timeline mode button ("tl-mode-button on", Layers) draws a 1 px box-shadow ring, which the flat-controls rule forbids. The mode switch arrived in 19c910e4 (2026-10-03).

tests: native dropdowns reopen and custom pickers toggle on repeated clicks
entries.reason: The 19th menu button, "Caption actions" (captions panel, 416e3a45, 2026-10-04), sits outside the viewport in the default layout, so the click never lands and the test times out.

tests: saving a large undo history yields to input and preserves the file
entries.reason: Longest main-thread gap while saving a 36 MB undo history was 220.6 ms (limit 100 ms) on both attempts and on the baseline run. Measured on the reference M4 Max while other lanes were compiling at nice 15; not yet re-measured on an idle machine.

tests: a sandboxed panel imports a 5 MB image, and copies only with the clipboard permission
entries.reason: Clicking inside the sandboxed panel never arms the gesture (outcome.armed stays false for 15 s). Same family as extension-sandbox.spec.ts: pointer input does not reach or focus the sandboxed view iframe in the hidden harness.

tests: a store extension’s Svelte panel renders in its own view iframe with host chrome and keys
entries.reason: Clicking the empty panel area leaves document.activeElement with no class (expected ext-panel-frame), so the sandboxed view never takes focus.

tests: drag a selection box, delete media, and undo the whole batch in both themes
entries.reason: Dragging across the media grid never shows .asset-selection-box (10 s). The selection box still exists in src; the drag start point or the library layout changed under the spec.

tests: a panel opens in a native window, keeps edits, and returns to the layout
entries.reason: getByRole(textbox, "Project notes") matches two textareas: the docked Notes panel and the Library's "Edit Notes" card preview. Strict-mode violation; spec or Library card markup needs to disambiguate.

tests: library shows a panel grid, adds panels to the workspace, and edits panels with the agent
entries.reason: The Library shows 14 panel cards; PM.PANELS (minus toolbar) has 15. One registered panel is missing from the Library grid.

tests: canvas and timeline open the same compact layer menu
entries.reason: The timeline layer menu has "Import Captions…" and the canvas layer menu does not (captions, 416e3a45). The two menus are meant to match.

tests: saved project files restore imported video without the original session media
entries.reason: After reopening a saved .pmv, the metadata-only re-save returns false. Passed once in the 2026-10-12 baseline suite; failed 9 of 9 later baseline runs and 4 of 4 runs after the Phase 0 amendment 14 fixes (rerun plus 3 repeats). Kept as flaky because it has passed once; not related to the restart-restore fix (it reopens the file explicitly).

tests: Settings › Project edits the live composition and its export settings
entries.reason: Settings tabs are project, general, accounts, transcription, extensions; the spec predates the Transcription tab (d63f9e55, 2026-10-04). Stale expectation.

tests: New project asks for the settings that matter before creating
entries.reason: The Background color dialog has no .fill-sv plane; the color picker anatomy changed in f8734eb3 ("unify color pickers", 2026-09-25). Stale selector.

tests: floating prompt attaches images and binary files, removes them, and sends their contents
entries.reason: CodexBridge.request receives 4 images (the attached PNG plus three 480x270 JPEG viewer captures); the spec expects only the attachment. Suspected visual-context frames from e7e3ccb1 bypassing the stubbed AgentHarness.observe.

tests: text, shader, extension, blend, and mask stopwatches animate their real values
entries.reason: The Studio Cube extension layer's "x.objectColor" stopwatch resolves but is never visible (collapsed or hidden section), so the click times out.

tests: keeps a usable window drag area with crowded tabs and overlays
entries.reason: The Library screen top is 42.32 px; the spec requires ≥ 44 px so it clears the titlebar drag area.

tests: compact layer rows keep names centered and parenting in dedicated controls
entries.reason: Clicking the row disclosure for the nested composition never reveals its child row "Prompt" (30 s timeout).

tests: the easing grid applies a curve to both Scale dimensions and preserves linear defaults
entries.reason: Choosing "Ease out" in the keyframe easing grid leaves both Scale keys at ei [1, 1] (expected [0.58, 1]); the menu item click does not apply the curve.

tests: the error toast matches the status toast it stacks with
entries.reason: The error toast has no "Technical details" button; it was removed in dbd1c23a ("Redesign agent errors", 2026-09-22). Stale spec.

tests: background picker keeps every channel above the hex field
entries.reason: The Background color dialog has no .color-dialog-value element (removed in f8734eb3, "unify color pickers"). Stale selector.

tests: resizes the selected layer in local space with a fixed opposite edge and correct cursors
entries.reason: Dragging the east handle leaves scale.x at 100. The handle hit-test works (the resize cursor matches) but the drag does not resize.

tests: resizes and rotates a multi-selection around the common pivot with one-step undo
entries.reason: The multi-selection resize drag leaves the shape scale at 100, the same failure as the single-layer case.
